title: Cohere launches North 2, an update to its enterprise agent platform with cross-session memory and a redesigned harness, available across cloud and on-premises (Sean Michael Kerner/VentureBeat)
summary: Sean Michael Kerner / VentureBeat: Cohere launches North 2, an update to its enterprise agent platform with cross-session memory and a redesigned harness, available across cloud and on-premises — Cohere is going after two common enterprise agent problems with North 2, the new version of its enterprise agent platform.
